title: iberis saxatilis var. subvelutina
intro: Iberis saxatilis var. subvelutina, commonly known as Rock Cress, is a perennial herb in the Brassicaceae family, native to the mountainous regions of the Mediterranean. Rock Cress has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress and anxiety, improve sleep quality, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Rock Cress include its ability to soothe skin irritations, calm digestive issues, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a popular choice for natural remedies. The bioactive constituents of Rock Cress include isothiocyanates, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
